description: Monday mornings: the numbers you care about for last week, next to the week before, with what changed most.
instructions_md: Report last week's {{metrics}}. Take them from the connected tools (such as Stripe, PostHog, Google Sheets or Zoho Books) or files I've shared. For each number: last week, the week before, the change in per cent and the same week four weeks ago. Then explain the two biggest changes in a sentence each, and say when you're guessing. Save the numbers in memory so you can compare next week. Don't change anything in those tools. If you can't reach a number, say which one and why, and don't estimate it.
